Victoria]] lost at home to [[C.D. Olimpia]] on week 1 with a 3–5 score. The game was later protested by Victoria due to the inclusion of [[Antonio Hernández (Honduran footballer)|Antonio Hernández]] in the Olimpia's lineup. Hernández, who had been sent off in the last game of the [[1990–91 Honduran Liga Nacional|previous season]], was inactive for one game. After two months of uncertainty, the Discipline Board decided to ignore Victoria's claim after they received a notification from Olimpia stating that Hernández complied with the suspension in an off-season friendly.[http://www.radiohouse.hn/casos-insolitos-del-futbol-hondureno/ RadioHouse.hn–CASOS INSÓLITOS DEL FÚTBOL HONDUREÑO]–13 October 2016 ==References== {{reflist}} {{Honduran Liga Nacional}} {{1991–92 in Honduran football}} {{DEFAULTSORT:1991-92 Honduran Liga Nacional}} [[Category:Liga Nacional de Fútbol Profesional de Honduras seasons]] [[Category:1991–92 in Honduran football]] [[Category:1991–92 in domestic association football leagues|Honduras]]
